review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped Mathlib for other categories of Alexandrov-discrete spaces. `AlexDisc` appears only in this file. The structure extends `TopCat` and reuses `InducedCategory` for its category, concrete-category and forget instances. `AlexDisc.of` and `delabOf` reuse the generic `CategoryTheory.delabOf`. `AlexDisc.Iso.mk` is the same kind of named isomorphism-from-homeomorphism constructor that `TopCat.isoOfHomeo` and the `Sequential` and `CompactlyGenerated` versions provide. The library applies this pattern consistently across categories of spaces, and this constructor takes the `AlexDisc` types directly. It is therefore a justified named specialisation, not a competing concept. The equivalence `alexDiscEquivPreord` builds on the existing `topToPreord`, `WithUpperSet`, and the specialization-order isomorphisms. I found no justified finding. The only residual uncertainty is that I did not compare `AlexDisc.Iso.mk` line by line with `Preord.Iso.mk`.
